preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The number of cities N must be between 2 and 200,000.
The number of main roads M must be between 0 and 120,000.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= x <= N and 1 <= y <= N and 1 <= S <= N
preconditions.description: The cities x, y, and the starting position S must be valid city indices between 1 and N.

postconditions.description: The output must contain N-1 integers representing the shortest distances from Rust's position to all other cities.
All distances in the output must be non-negative integers.
The output distances must be in ascending order based on vertex number.
